facts.fact: Article 9 of Decree 2020-146/PR/MI, issued after the Council of Ministers of 7 July 2020 and published 13 July 2020, states that the processed data of the National Register of Natural Persons (RNPP) are stored only on national territory; the document gives the publication date and no separate entry-into-force date.
facts.system: Decree 2020-146/PR/MI, Article 9 (RNPP data stored only on national territory)

systems.owner: Direction Generale de la Population et de la Famille (DGPF), with ANSIE for development and security
systems.tiers: public authorities, public and private bodies under Djiboutian law, their subcontractors
